review: 508.1a-1: 'starts the turn tapped' is undone by the untap step; delta now says Grizzly Bears is tapped when the declare attackers step begins.
508.1d-1: same untap-step problem in juggernaut_tapped; delta now says Juggernaut is tapped when the declare attackers step begins.
508.1k-1: after_combat variant changed the observation time rather than a fact of the setup or decisions; base now declares both creatures and the contrast leaves Hill Giant unchosen.
508.4d-1: no_ninjutsu and blocked do not exercise 508.4d (nothing enters attacking), relabelled other; the does_not_fire contrast (entering attacking before blockers) is the new scenario 508.4d-2.

508.5-1: Shock deals 2 damage and cannot kill the 3/3 Crypt Cobra; swapped for Lightning Bolt. removed_before_resolution also switched the attacked defender (two facts); it now keeps the attack on Jace Beleren. killed_before_blockers is a 508.3f outcome, relabelled other (in a two-player game the defending player is always B, so 508.5 has no does_not_fire branch).

508.7b-1: with Propaganda both variants dealt 2 to B and tapped Islands either way, so nothing observable flipped, and the contrast changed two facts; replaced Propaganda with Blazing Archon (creatures can't attack you), so the direct declaration is illegal while the reselection stands.
508.7c-1: notes said Portal Mage was already cast while it sat in hand with the Islands untapped; the declaration and cast are now decisions and the notes are empty.
508.8-1: one_attacker also added a block by Hill Giant, two facts and not needed for False Orders' target; delta is now only the declaration.

skipped 508.4a: the skip claimed no reachable case, but ninjutsu enters attacking the returned creature's planeswalker (702.49c), so removing that planeswalker in response reaches it. Added scenario 508.4a-1, dropped the skip, and reworded the 508.4b skip reason.
triage 508.1f: record_kinds was resolution, but tapping on declaration happens in no resolution; changed to combat. triage 508.8: added playability, which 508.8-1 uses.

skipped.reason: no Forge card states that an existing creature is attacking a specific planeswalker or battle fixed before the effect resolves, and the only player such an effect could name in a two-player game cannot leave without ending the game; the gone-defender outcome for a creature entering attacking is covered by 508.4a-1

scenarios.title: Only an untapped creature controlled continuously since the turn began is a legal attacker
decisions: A reaches the declare attackers step and declares Grizzly Bears as an attacker against B.

variants.label: untapped
variants.expected: Declaring Grizzly Bears as an attacker is legal.

variants.label: tapped
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears is tapped when the declare attackers step begins (it was tapped earlier in the turn).
variants.expected: Declaring Grizzly Bears as an attacker is illegal; it is not a legal attacker.

variants.label: summoning_sick
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears came under A's control this turn (summoning sick) and is untapped.
variants.expected: Declaring Grizzly Bears as an attacker is illegal; it is not a legal attacker.

scenarios.title: A summoning-sick creature with haste is a legal attacker, one without haste is not

setup.notes: Both creatures came under A's control this turn and are untapped.

decisions: A reaches the declare attackers step and declares Raging Goblin as an attacker against B.

variants.label: haste
variants.expected: Declaring Raging Goblin (haste) as an attacker is legal.

variants.label: no_haste
variants.delta: A declares Grizzly Bears (no haste) as the attacker instead of Raging Goblin.
variants.expected: Declaring Grizzly Bears as an attacker is illegal; it has not been controlled since the turn began and has no haste.

scenarios.title: A creature that can't attack alone makes a lone declaration illegal
decisions: A reaches the declare attackers step and declares Mogg Flunkies as the only attacker against B.

variants.label: alone
variants.expected: The declaration is illegal: Mogg Flunkies can't attack alone, so the game returns to the moment before the declaration.

variants.label: with_partner
variants.delta: A declares Mogg Flunkies and Grizzly Bears as attackers.
variants.expected: The declaration is legal; both creatures become attacking creatures.

variants.label: partner_alone
variants.delta: A declares only Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The declaration is legal; Grizzly Bears is the only attacking creature.

scenarios.title: A creature that can't attack unless the defending player controls an Island is checked at declaration
decisions: A reaches the declare attackers step and declares Dandân as an attacker against B.

variants.label: no_island
variants.expected: Declaring Dandân is illegal: the defending player controls no Island, so it can't attack.

variants.label: island
variants.delta: B controls an Island instead of a Mountain.
variants.expected: Declaring Dandân is legal; it becomes an attacking creature.

scenarios.title: A creature that attacks each combat if able must be in the declaration
decisions: A reaches the declare attackers step and declares only Grizzly Bears as an attacker against B.

variants.label: requirement_ignored
variants.expected: The declaration is illegal: Juggernaut must attack and is not declared, so fewer requirements are obeyed than possible.

variants.label: requirement_met
variants.delta: A declares Juggernaut and Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The declaration is legal.

variants.label: juggernaut_tapped
variants.delta: Juggernaut is tapped when the declare attackers step begins (it was tapped earlier in the turn), and A declares only Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The declaration is legal; a tapped Juggernaut is not able to attack, so the requirement does not apply.

scenarios.title: The number of obeyed requirements must be the maximum possible without breaking a restriction
decisions: A reaches the declare attackers step and declares only Juggernaut as an attacker against B.

variants.label: only_required
variants.expected: The declaration is legal: it obeys Juggernaut's requirement without breaking Silent Arbiter's restriction of one attacker.

variants.label: wrong_one
variants.delta: A declares only Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The declaration is illegal: zero requirements are obeyed while one could be.

variants.label: both
variants.delta: A declares Juggernaut and Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The declaration is illegal: two attackers break the restriction that no more than one creature can attack.

variants.label: none
variants.delta: A declares no attackers.
variants.expected: The declaration is illegal: Juggernaut's requirement could be obeyed and is not.

scenarios.title: A player is not required to pay an attack cost even if paying would obey a requirement
decisions: A reaches the declare attackers step with both Mountains untapped and declares no attackers.

variants.label: decline_to_pay
variants.expected: The declaration is legal: Propaganda's {2} cost need not be paid, so Juggernaut is not required to attack even though A could pay.

variants.label: pay
variants.delta: A declares Juggernaut as an attacker against B and pays {2} with both Mountains.
variants.expected: The declaration is legal; Juggernaut becomes an attacking creature and both Mountains are tapped.

variants.label: cannot_pay
variants.delta: Both Mountains are tapped and A declares Juggernaut as an attacker against B.
variants.expected: The declaration is illegal: the {2} cost can't be paid.

scenarios.forge_notes: Propaganda's cost is an optional attack payment in Forge; check that declaring no attackers is accepted while Juggernaut could pay.

scenarios.title: Declared attackers become tapped unless they have vigilance
decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears as the only attacker against B.
No spells or abilities are used.

variants.label: tapped
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears becomes tapped as it is declared as an attacker, without any cost being paid. Serra Angel stays untapped.

variants.label: vigilance
variants.delta: A declares Serra Angel as the only attacker instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Serra Angel is an attacking creature and stays untapped. Grizzly Bears stays untapped.

variants.label: not_declared
variants.delta: A declares no attackers.
variants.expected: Neither creature becomes tapped.

scenarios.title: A chosen creature becomes an attacking creature and stays one until combat ends
decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears and Hill Giant as attackers against B.
No spells or abilities are used, B declares no blockers, and combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: both_chosen
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears and Hill Giant are both attacking creatures and deal 5 combat damage to B (life 15).

variants.label: giant_not_chosen
variants.delta: A declares only Grizzly Bears; Hill Giant is not chosen.
variants.expected: Only Grizzly Bears is an attacking creature; Hill Giant is not attacking. B takes 2 combat damage (life 18).

scenarios.title: An attack trigger is on the stack before the active player first gets priority
decisions: A casts Jump targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Island. Both players pass; Jump resolves and Grizzly Bears has flying until end of turn.
A moves to combat and declares Grizzly Bears as the only attacker against B.
Raking Canopy's trigger (a flying creature attacks B) goes on the stack before A receives priority.
A, holding priority first, casts Giant Growth targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Forest. Both players pass; Giant Growth resolves.
Both players pass; Raking Canopy's trigger resolves and deals 4 damage to Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: respond
variants.expected: Raking Canopy's trigger fires at declaration and is already on the stack when A first gets priority. Giant Growth resolves first, so Grizzly Bears is 5/5, takes 4 damage and survives; B takes 5 combat damage (life 15).

variants.label: no_response
variants.delta: A does not cast Giant Growth; A passes priority with the trigger on the stack.
variants.expected: The trigger resolves and deals 4 damage to Grizzly Bears (2/2), which dies in the state-based check. B takes no combat damage (life 20).

variants.label: no_flying
variants.delta: A does not cast Jump, so Grizzly Bears does not have flying when declared.
variants.expected: Raking Canopy's trigger does not fire. Grizzly Bears deals 2 combat damage to B (life 18).

scenarios.title: An attack trigger does not fire when an attacker later gains the quality it names
decisions: A moves to combat and declares Grizzly Bears as the only attacker against B.
A casts Jump targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Island. Both players pass; Jump resolves.

variants.label: flying_after_declaration
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has no flying when declared, so Raking Canopy does not trigger even after Jump gives it flying. Grizzly Bears survives and deals 2 combat damage to B (life 18).

variants.label: flying_before_declaration
variants.delta: A casts Jump in the first main phase, before combat, and then declares Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has flying when declared, so Raking Canopy's trigger fires and deals 4 damage to it. Grizzly Bears dies; B's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: A creature put onto the battlefield attacking never attacked, so attack triggers do not fire for it
decisions: A declares Brimaz, King of Oreskos as the only attacker against B; Hellrider and Grizzly Bears stay home.
Hellrider's trigger (for Brimaz) and Brimaz's trigger go on the stack. Brimaz's trigger creates a Cat Soldier token that is attacking B.
No further spells or abilities are used; B declares no blockers and combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: token_enters_attacking
variants.expected: Hellrider triggers once, for Brimaz, and deals 1 damage to B. The Cat Soldier token that enters attacking never attacked, so Hellrider does not trigger for it. Combat damage is 3 from Brimaz and 1 from the token: B's life is 15.

variants.label: declared_creature
variants.delta: A declares Brimaz and Grizzly Bears as attackers.
variants.expected: Hellrider triggers twice, for Brimaz and for Grizzly Bears (2 damage to B), and not for the token. Combat damage is 3 + 2 + 1: B's life is 12.

scenarios.forge_notes: The Cat Soldier token enters attacking without being declared; the count of Hellrider triggers is the observable.

scenarios.title: A player-is-attacked trigger fires once when creatures are declared attacking that player

setup.notes: Curse of Vitality is controlled by A and attached to player B.

decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears and Hill Giant as attackers against B.
No spells or abilities are used besides triggers.

variants.label: two_attackers_player
variants.expected: Curse of Vitality triggers once: A gains 2 life (life 22), not 4. B is the player attacked.

variants.label: attack_planeswalker
variants.delta: A declares both creatures as attackers against Jace Beleren instead of B.
variants.expected: Curse of Vitality does not trigger, because B was not attacked. A's life stays 20.

variants.label: no_attackers
variants.delta: A declares no attackers.
variants.expected: Curse of Vitality does not trigger. A's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: An attacks-with-a-creature trigger fires when a qualifying creature of that player is declared
decisions: A declares Hired Claw as the only attacker against B.
Hired Claw's trigger targets B.

variants.label: lizard_attacks
variants.expected: Hired Claw's trigger fires and deals 1 damage to B; B's life is 19 when the trigger has resolved.

variants.label: only_bear_attacks
variants.delta: A declares Grizzly Bears as the only attacker instead of Hired Claw.
variants.expected: No Lizard is declared, so Hired Claw's trigger does not fire. B's life is 20 before combat damage.

variants.label: lizard_and_bear
variants.delta: A declares Hired Claw and Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Hired Claw's trigger fires once and deals 1 damage to B; B's life is 19 when the trigger has resolved.

scenarios.title: A whenever-you-attack trigger fires once however many creatures are declared
decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears and Hill Giant as attackers against B; Ancestor Dragon stays home.

variants.label: two_attackers
variants.expected: Ancestor Dragon triggers once and A gains 1 life for each attacking creature: A's life is 22.

variants.label: one_attacker
variants.delta: A declares only Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Ancestor Dragon triggers once and A gains 1 life: A's life is 21.

variants.label: no_attackers
variants.delta: A declares no attackers.
variants.expected: Ancestor Dragon does not trigger. A's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: A whenever-you-attack-a-player trigger fires for attackers attacking the player but not a planeswalker
decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears as the only attacker against B; Horizon Explorer stays home.

variants.label: attack_player
variants.expected: Horizon Explorer's trigger fires and A creates a Lander token.

variants.label: attack_planeswalker
variants.delta: A declares Grizzly Bears as an attacker against Jace Beleren instead of B.
variants.expected: Horizon Explorer's trigger does not fire; A creates no Lander token.

variants.label: no_attackers
variants.delta: A declares no attackers.
variants.expected: Horizon Explorer's trigger does not fire; A creates no Lander token.

scenarios.title: An attacks-and-isn't-blocked trigger fires in the declare blockers step
decisions: A declares Crypt Cobra as the only attacker against B.
B declares no blockers.
No spells or abilities are used.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.expected: Nothing triggers when Crypt Cobra is declared. In the declare blockers step, once it is unblocked, its trigger fires and B gets 1 poison counter.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B blocks Crypt Cobra with Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Crypt Cobra's trigger does not fire. B has no poison counters.

scenarios.title: A creature that would enter attacking a planeswalker that has left the battlefield enters but is not attacking
decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears as the only attacker against Jace Beleren.
B declares no blockers.
In the declare blockers step A activates ninjutsu of Ninja of the Deep Hours, tapping both Islands and returning Grizzly Bears to hand.
Holding priority, A casts Lightning Bolt targeting Jace Beleren, tapping Mountain. Both players pass; Lightning Bolt resolves.
Both players pass; the ninjutsu ability resolves. Combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: planeswalker_gone
variants.expected: Jace Beleren (loyalty 3) is dealt 3 damage and goes to B's graveyard. Ninja of the Deep Hours enters the battlefield tapped but is not an attacking creature and deals no combat damage. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: planeswalker_present
variants.delta: A does not cast Lightning Bolt.
variants.expected: Ninja of the Deep Hours enters tapped and attacking Jace Beleren and deals 2 combat damage to it; Jace Beleren has loyalty 1. B's life stays 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Ninjutsu enters attacking the defender of the returned creature (702.49c). Check that Forge leaves the Ninja non-attacking rather than redirecting it to B when that planeswalker is gone.

scenarios.title: A creature put onto the battlefield attacking ignores attack restrictions
decisions: A declares Brimaz, King of Oreskos as the only attacker against B.
Brimaz's trigger creates a Cat Soldier token that is attacking B.
B declares no blockers and combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: token_ignores_cap
variants.expected: The declaration is legal and Brimaz's token enters attacking despite Silent Arbiter's limit of one attacker, so two creatures attack. Combat damage is 3 + 1: B's life is 16.

variants.label: second_declared
variants.delta: A declares Brimaz and Grizzly Bears as attackers.
variants.expected: The declaration is illegal: two declared attackers break Silent Arbiter's restriction.

scenarios.title: A creature put onto the battlefield attacking after blockers are declared is unblocked
decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears as the only attacker against B.
B declares no blockers (Hill Giant stays untapped but does not block).
In the declare blockers step A activates ninjutsu, tapping both Islands and returning Grizzly Bears to hand; Ninja of the Deep Hours enters tapped and attacking B.
Combat damage is dealt; A takes the optional draw.

variants.label: ninjutsu
variants.expected: Ninja of the Deep Hours enters tapped, attacking and unblocked; Hill Giant cannot block it. It deals 2 combat damage to B (life 18) and A draws a card.

variants.label: no_ninjutsu
variants.delta: A does not activate ninjutsu.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears stays unblocked and deals 2 combat damage to B (life 18). Ninja of the Deep Hours stays in A's hand and A draws no card.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B blocks Grizzly Bears with Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Ninjutsu can't be activated because Grizzly Bears is blocked. Hill Giant deals 3 damage to Grizzly Bears, which dies; B's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: A creature put onto the battlefield attacking before blockers are declared can still be blocked
decisions: A declares Brimaz, King of Oreskos as the only attacker against B.
Brimaz's trigger resolves in the declare attackers step and creates a 1/1 Cat Soldier token that is attacking B.
In the declare blockers step B blocks the Cat Soldier token with Hill Giant.
No spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: token_blocked
variants.expected: The token entered attacking in the declare attackers step, so it is not unblocked: Hill Giant blocks it and it dies. Brimaz deals 3 combat damage to B (life 17).

variants.label: no_block
variants.delta: B declares no blockers.
variants.expected: The token and Brimaz are unblocked and deal 4 combat damage to B (life 16).

scenarios.forge_notes: Pairs with 508.4d-1, where a creature entering attacking in the declare blockers step is unblocked and cannot be blocked.

scenarios.title: The defending player is the attacked player or the controller of the attacked planeswalker, even after the creature leaves combat
decisions: A declares Crypt Cobra as the only attacker against Jace Beleren.
B declares no blockers; B casts no spells.
Crypt Cobra's trigger fires and resolves.

variants.label: attacks_planeswalker
variants.expected: The defending player is B, controller of the attacked planeswalker: B gets 1 poison counter and A gets none.

variants.label: attacks_player
variants.delta: A declares Crypt Cobra as an attacker against B instead of Jace Beleren.
variants.expected: The defending player is B: B gets 1 poison counter and A gets none.

variants.label: removed_before_resolution
variants.delta: With Crypt Cobra's trigger on the stack, B casts Lightning Bolt targeting Crypt Cobra, tapping Mountain.
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt resolves first and Crypt Cobra (3/3) dies, so it is no longer attacking. The trigger still refers to the controller of the planeswalker it was attacking: B gets 1 poison counter.

variants.label: killed_before_blockers
variants.delta: In the declare attackers step, before blockers are declared, B casts Lightning Bolt targeting Crypt Cobra, tapping Mountain.
variants.expected: Crypt Cobra dies before blockers are declared, so it never attacks unblocked and its trigger does not fire. B has no poison counters.

scenarios.title: A reselected attacker stays in combat and does not attack a second time
decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears as the only attacker against Jace Beleren.
Hellrider triggers and deals 1 damage to Jace Beleren (loyalty 2).
A casts Portal Mage, tapping three Islands. Portal Mage enters during the declare attackers step; its trigger targets Grizzly Bears and A reselects B as the player it attacks.
B declares no blockers and combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: reselect_to_player
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears stays an attacking creature and now attacks B. Hellrider does not trigger a second time, so Jace Beleren stays at loyalty 2. Grizzly Bears deals 2 combat damage to B (life 18).

variants.label: no_reselect
variants.delta: A does not cast Portal Mage.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears keeps attacking Jace Beleren and deals 2 damage to it. Jace Beleren has 0 loyalty after the Hellrider damage and combat damage and dies; B's life stays 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Portal Mage's trigger is optional (OptionalDecider$ You); the scenario takes the 'may' as accepted.

scenarios.title: A creature whose attacked defender is reselected ignores a restriction on attacking the new defender
decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears as the only attacker against Jace Beleren; Blazing Archon forbids attacking B, not B's planeswalkers.
A casts Portal Mage, tapping three Islands. It enters during the declare attackers step; its trigger targets Grizzly Bears and A reselects B as the player it attacks.
B declares no blockers and combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: reselect
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears now attacks B despite Blazing Archon and stays in combat. It deals 2 combat damage to B (life 18); Jace Beleren keeps loyalty 3.

variants.label: declare_at_player
variants.delta: A declares Grizzly Bears as an attacker against B instead of Jace Beleren.
variants.expected: The declaration is illegal: Blazing Archon says creatures can't attack B.

scenarios.forge_notes: Portal Mage's trigger is optional (OptionalDecider$ You); the scenario takes it as accepted. Check that Forge's ChangeCombatants does not filter the new defender by attack restrictions.

scenarios.title: A reselected defender must be an opponent or an opposing planeswalker
decisions: A declares Grizzly Bears as the only attacker against Jace Beleren.
A casts Portal Mage, tapping three Islands. It enters during the declare attackers step and its trigger targets Grizzly Bears.
A reselects Grizzly Bears' defender: the chosen new defender is B.

variants.label: reselect_opponent
variants.expected: Choosing B is legal.

variants.label: reselect_own_planeswalker
variants.delta: The chosen new defender is A's own Chandra Nalaar.
variants.expected: Choosing Chandra Nalaar is illegal; it is not controlled by an opponent of the attacking creature's controller.

variants.label: reselect_self
variants.delta: The chosen new defender is A.
variants.expected: Choosing A is illegal; A is not an opponent of the attacking creature's controller.

scenarios.title: With no attackers the declare blockers and combat damage steps are skipped
decisions: A declares no attackers.
B wants to cast False Orders targeting Hill Giant during the declare blockers step, tapping Mountain.

variants.label: no_attackers
variants.expected: The declare blockers step is skipped; combat goes from declare attackers to end of combat. B never has a declare blockers step in which False Orders can be cast.

variants.label: one_attacker
variants.delta: A declares Grizzly Bears as an attacker against B.
variants.expected: The declare blockers step happens, and casting False Orders targeting Hill Giant is legal there.
